title: Prescriptions and finishing the visit
summary: Write a prescription from a medicine set, issue it, and end the visit.

steps.title: Open the patient
steps.narration: Open Patients from the menu, then tap the patient you are about to see.

steps.title: Pick the patient
steps.narration: You can also search by name. Tap the patient's row to open their file.

steps.title: Start the visit
steps.narration: On the patient's file, tap Start visit. The timer starts, and the notes panel opens on the right.

steps.title: Note the complaint
steps.narration: Tap a chip to note the complaint. You can also type, or speak your note.

steps.title: Medicine sets
steps.narration: Scroll to Prescription. A medicine set fills in the usual medicines in one tap. Choose the set that fits.

steps.title: Check the medicines
steps.narration: Check each medicine, its dose, how often, and when to take it. Change anything you need, or remove a line.

steps.title: Issue the prescription
steps.narration: When it looks right, tap Issue prescription. The patient is sent a link by email or message.

steps.title: Tell the patient the PIN
steps.narration: The patient needs this PIN to open the prescription. Tell it to them, or write it on their copy. It is shown only once.

steps.title: End the visit
steps.narration: When you are done with the patient, tap End visit.

steps.title: On to payment
steps.narration: The visit is closed. Now you or the front desk can tap Collect payment, or Send for payment to the patient's phone.
